```sql
WITH UserSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.user_id,
        o.order_date,
        SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS order_total
    FROM 
        Orders o
    JOIN 
        Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN 
        Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY 
        o.order_id, o.user_id, o.order_date
),
CumulativeSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        us.order_id,
        us.user_id,
        us.order_date,
        us.order_total,
        SUM(us.order_total) OVER (
            PARTITION BY us.user_id 
            ORDER BY us.order_date, us.order_id
        ) AS running_total
    FROM 
        UserSpending us
)
SELECT 
    cs.order_id,
    cs.user_id,
    cs.running_total
FROM 
    CumulativeSpending cs
ORDER BY 
    cs.user_id, cs.order_date, cs.order_id;
```
